findings.claim: task record for a footered code commit was untracked: the local fence reads the working tree and passed, but a CI clone would refuse the delivering push (lanes 3/4/5/7/8)
adoption base is client-authored from the audited HEAD and .stallion-base/.githooks/.github were not code paths: unfooted code plus a base bump could smuggle past the fence (lanes 1/8)
doctor CI check was self-certifying: the doctor's own step line or a --staged-only hook satisfied the wiring detectors (lanes 3/5/8)
the committed-base tier shipped with zero live executions: local config shadowed it everywhere and fixtures were inert strings (lanes 4/7)
local git-config tier could shrink the fence below the committed base invisibly: the moved-base guard reads only the committed file, and the doctor blessed any non-empty range
a docs-only task at executing was a master key for code at both gates; unrelated and never-finishing tasks authorize anything (role-level, no tenancy)
authorization is forgeable plain JSON: hand-written records and self-approvable DECISIONS.md headings pass shape checks (documented boundary class)
findings.justification: the plain-JSON trust boundary is documented law (WIRING: What is deliberately NOT enforced): records and registers are reviewable, git history is the tamper evidence, and cryptographic signatures are registered future work.

findings.claim: doctor wiring detectors accepted an echo line or --base HEAD~1 as the fence: substring, not invocation
revParseOk accepted non-commits and relative refs; the committed base file was unvalidated (now strict 40-hex commit)
empty --base value was silently swallowed instead of refused
rangeCount converted git failures into 0 and misreported them as a vacuous base, coaching an unnecessary base change
stale three-tier order in the committed pre-push hook and resolvePushBase docstring; one remedy omitted git commit
WIRING.md package.json template lacked the selftest script that AGENTS.md and CI reference
the local activation check was armed nowhere automated: CI skips it and no hook ran the doctor locally
the CI delta step trusts github.event.before alone; history accepted by a shadowed local fence is never re-audited by it
the RED pin was arity-only: the committed-vs-origin fixture passed under the pre-fix signature, proving only that a fourth argument existed
CI=true visibly skips the activation checks: a client-set env remains the discriminator (documented compromise, clone config cannot travel)
findings.justification: clone-local config cannot travel to CI; the doctor visibly prints the skip and the push CI re-fences — the alternative (failing every CI run) rejects a state CI cannot observe.

findings.claim: committedBase carried a dead try/catch around a non-throwing body
origin-tracking tier is unreachable in CI (detached HEAD): it is a local-clone convenience only
the wave's adversarial artifacts (bundles, register) were untracked, leaving the audit trail off-repo
no task-to-file tenancy: any in-flight task authorizes any staged code, and nothing expires a task parked at executing forever (registered future work)
--staged combined with --doctor silently ran only the staged gate; the combination is now refused outright (this claim needed the --claim= form: the strict parser refuses dash-leading values)

register correction: f21 cited a refute bundle as resolution evidence for the missing task-to-file tenancy, which is registered future work, not a repair — corrected here because resolutions are append-only
findings.justification: task-to-file binding is the registered task-commit binding future work; today the push gate demands a per-commit footer naming a specific valid record, and in-flight staleness is bounded by review of the register's git history.
